rule: A deployed version passes when, for each case, its answer carries the same facts as tool_output.

cases.question: Someone asks which dispatch stages are recorded as complete and whether request assessment, technician search, reservation or notification is next. Use the FieldServiceDispatch tool on the sample.
cases.tool_output:
{
  "completed": [],
  "external_work_performed": false,
  "next_stage": "Assess request",
  "request": "Northwind sample service request",
  "scope": "Design-only checklist; no technician or slot is reserved.",
  "stages": [
    "Assess request",
    "Find technician",
    "Reserve slot",
    "Notify customer"
  ]
}
cases.local_answer:
No dispatch stages are recorded as complete for the sample Northwind service request. The next stage is **request assessment** (“Assess request”).

The full sequence is:
1. Assess request (next)
2. Find technician
3. Reserve slot
4. Notify customer

This is a design-only checklist. No technician has been found, no slot is reserved, and no customer has been notified.
